answer: In this PoA design, each identity is bound to a Wesolowski VDF whose challenge requires a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings. A vertex that tries to wander through many clone identities must complete every chain independently: GPUs may improve throughput across separate instances, but cannot parallelize the dependency within one chain. Thus even a cedar-sized compute farm faces a strict physical time bottleneck, making Sybil expansion costly and detectable.
